key.beaconrange.pin: Pin the beacon or conduit you look at
beaconrange.pin.no_beacon: Look at a beacon or conduit to pin it
beaconrange.pin.gone: The beacon at %s is gone and was unpinned.
beaconrange.button.tooltip: Keeps the range of this beacon visible, even when you look away or leave. Pins are saved for this world. Click again to unpin.
beaconrange.command.list.empty: Nothing pinned in this dimension. Open a beacon and click "Pin range", or look at a conduit and use /beaconrange pin.
beaconrange.command.remove.invalid: "%s" is not a position - use x y z
beaconrange.config.title: Beacon Range Settings
beaconrange.config.show_on_look.desc: Shows the range of a beacon or conduit while you look at it - from up to 96 blocks away.
beaconrange.config.look_info.desc: Shows level and range below the crosshair while you look at a beacon or conduit.
beaconrange.walls.fade.desc: Strong up to the beacon, then fading out towards the sky.
beaconrange.walls.full.desc: Evenly all the way up - the range has no top.
beaconrange.config.opacity.desc: How strongly the walls are tinted.
beaconrange.config.edges.desc: Glowing lines along the corners of the range.
beaconrange.config.height_line.desc: A line around the range at your height - shows where it ends right where you are.
beaconrange.color_mode.level.desc: Each level has its own color, set below.
beaconrange.color_mode.beam.desc: Same color as the beam - dye it with stained glass on top of the beacon.
beaconrange.config.pins.world: %s in this world, %s in all worlds.
beaconrange.config.pins.menu: %s in all worlds. Join a world to unpin what is pinned there.
beaconrange.config.tutorial.desc: Shows the quick tour of this mod again.
beaconrange.tutorial.description: Shows exactly where the effects of a beacon or conduit reach.
beaconrange.tutorial.look.title: Look at a beacon
beaconrange.tutorial.look.text: Look at an active beacon - even from far away - and its range appears around it. The effects reach 20 to 50 blocks to each side, just as far down and all the way up to the sky. The color shows the level.
beaconrange.tutorial.pin.title: Pin it
beaconrange.tutorial.pin.text: Open the beacon and click "Pin range" to keep the range visible when you look away or leave. Pins are saved per world. /beaconrange list shows all of them.
beaconrange.tutorial.settings.title: Make it yours
beaconrange.tutorial.settings.text: Pick colors and wall styles in the settings. Open them through Mod Menu, or bind keys under Controls > Beacon Range - one pins a beacon without opening it.
beaconrange.news.2_0_1.edges: Fixed: the edges of a range now fade out above the beacon instead of staying bright up to the sky.
beaconrange.news.2_0_0.range: The range now matches Minecraft exactly: it reaches all the way up to the sky.
beaconrange.news.2_0_0.look: New look: glowing edges, walls that fade out towards the sky and a line at your height.
beaconrange.news.2_0_0.saved: Pinned beacons are saved per world and stay pinned when you walk away or rejoin.
beaconrange.news.2_0_0.button: New "Pin range" button in the beacon screen. Level and range show under your crosshair, even from far away.
beaconrange.news.2_0_0.settings: Settings with colors per level, wall styles and keys to pin or hide ranges.
beaconrange.pin.gone_conduit: The conduit at %s is gone and was unpinned.
beaconrange.conduit.inactive: Inactive conduit · frame %s/%s, needs water all around
beaconrange.button.lock.on.desc: A pin is removed as soon as its beacon is gone. Turn this off on servers that hide blocks (anti-xray), so your pins stay.
beaconrange.button.lock.off.desc: Pins stay even when the beacon seems gone, for example when the server hides it. Remove them with /beaconrange list.
beaconrange.auto_unpin.on: Pins are removed automatically when the beacon is gone
beaconrange.auto_unpin.off: Pins stay, even when the beacon seems gone
beaconrange.config.conduits.desc: Shows the range of a conduit as a sphere - 32 to 96 blocks, depending on its frame.
beaconrange.config.conduit_attack.desc: With a full frame (42 blocks) a conduit attacks hostile mobs within 8 blocks - shown as a red box.
beaconrange.config.auto_unpin.desc: Removes a pin when its beacon or conduit is gone. Turn off on servers that hide blocks (anti-xray).
beaconrange.tutorial.conduit.title: Conduits too
beaconrange.tutorial.conduit.text: Look at a conduit to see its range as a sphere: 32 to 96 blocks, depending on its frame. With a full frame, a red box shows where it attacks mobs. Pin it with /beaconrange pin or the pin key.
beaconrange.news.2_1_0.conduit: Conduits: look at one to see its range as a sphere. Pin it with /beaconrange pin or the pin key.
beaconrange.news.2_1_0.keep: New lock button next to "Pin range": turn off automatic unpinning on servers that hide blocks.
beaconrange.news.2_1_0.fixes: Look at a beacon's pyramid to see its range - handy when you stand below it. Plus many fixes, for example for servers that hide blocks.
beaconrange.config.pins.clear.title: Unpin everything?
beaconrange.config.pins.clear.question: This unpins all %s beacons and conduits in this world. You can't undo it.
